tasks.short: Organize study equipment and supply space

steps.what: Inspect the available study space and equipment access requirements
Read the actual equipment storage, segregation and environmental requirements
Arrange the study equipment and supplies in the actual available space
outputs: organised study storage and accessible equipment

tasks.design: Keep physical space organisation manual and read the existing storage instructions from {DOCS} separately. A native document view was considered, but the stated work supplies no repeated record write, stock transaction or additional lookup change beyond the current instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Available space and equipment handling constraints must be assessed physically.
tasks.enabler_now: No further change is established for the actual work in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Segregation, access and environmental constraints vary with the room and study equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator sees whether the arrangement works in the real space.
tasks.altitude: Physical organisation and its existing instruction lookup stay with the coordinator.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: physical study storage organisation requires checking actual space against equipment instructions.

assumptions: No new location register or inventory log is assumed merely because equipment is moved.
If actual local practice requires a storage-location record, it must be added with its real entry time before estimating that branch.
research_questions: Does actual practice include a separate storage-location entry that this task description does not establish?

already_counted.description: All inspection, instruction reading and physical arrangement remain in s1 through s3.

incremental.description: No process change or additional upkeep is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Physical work and the actual instruction lookup are separated. No repeated record, send or changed lookup operation is demonstrated, so all time stays retained and no upkeep is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify the protocol, eligibility, participant burden and permitted subject recruitment claims
Draft advertising and informational materials for subject recruitment using the verified study brief

loop.purpose: Draft recruitment prose restricted to the checked study brief
loop.input: Protocol-linked verified eligibility, burden, contacts and permitted claims
loop.output: Draft recruitment copy with source-linked factual claims
loop.check: Coordinator checks benefit language, omitted burdens, eligibility negation, participant understanding and every factual claim against the protocol
loop.stop: Missing protocol support or two failed revisions returns the copy to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use fixed approved wording and a native layout first; only variable plain-language prose needs a bounded loop

steps.what: Edit and check the finished recruitment materials against the protocol and participant needs
outputs: checked final recruitment materials for the required study review

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} layout and fixed permitted wording before a bounded loop drafts variable recruitment prose from coordinator-checked study facts. The coordinator checks and repairs the completed material; this development task ends before any separate ethics submission, publication or recruitment send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Variable participant-facing prose must be written around detailed study requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose plain wording while keeping the protocol as its only factual source.
tasks.still_hard: Recruitment language can overstate benefit or conceal participant burden.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator judges whether a potential participant would understand the actual study.
tasks.altitude: Assist initial prose while retaining full protocol and participant review.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-constrained drafting can propose recruitment prose but needs protocol and participant-language checking.

assumptions: Shares and draft reduction are unmeasured hypotheses.
The coordinator prepares the verified source brief in s1; no extracted eligibility list arrives free.
Required study and ethics review remains required before use and is not replaced by the author's editing.
Any actual submission or publication needs its own version-bound approval and send step outside this material-development estimate.
research_questions: Does the initial draft reduce writing after checking omitted burdens and overstated benefits?

already_counted.description: Check generated meaning in s2 and manually repair rejected prose in s3.

incremental.description: Amortised source-link and recruitment-language regression checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Initial prose removes 30*0.20=6 hours less 0.8 upkeep, net 5.2. Cautious case: an unusually burdensome protocol needs almost complete manual rewriting, leaving only 1 hour of routine contact and introduction wording removed and 0.2 net; rewrite effort consumes the rest of the initial drafting benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Dispense study drugs or devices with dosage calculations and instructions

steps.what: Verify the prescriber's current order, participant identity, protocol, concentration and required dosing inputs
inputs: actual weight and required clinical inputs

steps.what: Calculate the ordered study-drug dosage from verified units, concentration and protocol formula
Check and approve the exact participant, dose, product and written dispensing instructions
outputs: checked final dispensing instruction and approved participant-specific dose

steps.what: Prepare the actual ordered drug or device and verify its identity, expiry and quantity
inputs: checked final dispensing instruction and approved participant-specific dose
outputs: prepared and physically checked study product

steps.what: Dispense the checked medical device or drug to the approved participant
inputs: prepared and physically checked study product
checked final dispensing instruction and approved participant-specific dose

steps.what: Explain the actual use instructions and confirm the participant understands them
inputs: checked final dispensing instruction and approved participant-specific dose
outputs: explained instructions and checked participant understanding

steps.what: Enter the actual dispensing quantity, product lot, participant and date in the accountability record
inputs: actual product lot and dispensing event

tasks.design: Configure a validated fixed-formula calculator in the authorised {OTHER} clinical research system and keep unit, dose-limit and prescriber-order checks with the qualified coordinator. OTHER denotes clinical research dispensing and accountability software; approval binds the final participant-specific instruction before physical dispensing, while explanation and actual accountability entry remain separate and manual.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated ordered-dose arithmetic may still be carried out manually.
tasks.enabler_now: A validated fixed formula can reproduce the arithmetic from verified patient-specific inputs without prescribing.
tasks.still_hard: Correct patient, order, formulation and physical product must be verified at dispensing.
tasks.human_edge: A qualified person retains clinical accountability and confirms participant understanding.
tasks.altitude: Remove repeated arithmetic while retaining authorised dispensing and counselling.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: validated clinical calculators can perform fixed dose arithmetic but do not replace prescriber orders or qualified checks.

assumptions: The modelled coordinator is legally qualified and already authorised to dispense under a current prescriber order; otherwise dispensing remains with the actual qualified role and the graph must be reweighted.
The prescriber produces the order; clinical measurements come from actual qualified clinical assessment and are verified in s1, not inferred from free text.
Shares are hypotheses for a drug-dispensing branch still doing arithmetic manually; an existing calculator yields no additional arithmetic saving.

Inputs include participant ID, order version, weight when required, units, concentration, formula version and dose limits; missing or inconsistent inputs stop calculation for manual resolution in s1 and s3.
Device-only dispensing without dosage arithmetic must be reweighted and cannot claim s2's saving.
research_questions: Can the existing authorised system implement the exact protocol formula with validated unit and limit checks?

already_counted.description: Verify inputs in s1 and independently check and repair calculation and written instructions in s3.

incremental.description: Amortised clinical formula validation and version-regression checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact participant, prescriber order version, product, dose and final written instructions; any changed input or product voids approval and physical identity checks in s4 remain mandatory

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Fixed arithmetic removes 10 hours less 1.5 validation upkeep, net 8.5. Cautious case: protocol exceptions and unit conflicts require manual calculation for most orders, leaving only 2 hours of validated routine arithmetic removed and 0.5 net; additional resolution work consumes the rest of the nominal arithmetic benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange study sites and check staff and equipment availability

steps.what: Read the study's actual site, staffing, equipment and visit-timing requirements
Contact site staff and verify the actual availability of required people, rooms and equipment
outputs: confirmed site resource availability and constraints

steps.what: Write the actual site arrangement request with confirmed dates, people and equipment
inputs: confirmed site resource availability and constraints

steps.what: Check and approve the completed site request, dates, resource scope and recipients
outputs: approved site request version and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved arrangement request to the named study-site contacts
inputs: approved site request version and recipients

steps.what: Reconcile the site response and enter the actual confirmed arrangement in the study calendar

tasks.design: Reuse a native {DOCS} site-request layout after the coordinator confirms real resource availability with site contacts. Approve the completed request before its separate {EMAIL} send, then retain response reconciliation and the actual {CALENDAR} entry; the template does not book unconfirmed resources.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring study and resource headings can be re-entered in arrangement requests.
tasks.enabler_now: A request template supplies stable structure while the coordinator supplies confirmed facts.
tasks.still_hard: Calendar availability does not prove staff competence or usable study equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator resolves conflicting resource constraints with the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Small request-writing reuse while keeping real feasibility coordination.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates can reuse recurring site arrangement fields.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured hypotheses for an existing request-and-confirmation path.
The coordinator obtains dates, named staff roles, room and equipment identity, availability limits and site contacts in s2; missing confirmations remain manual.
The site produces its actual response; its labour is unchanged and no new capture work is transferred.
Requests remain within an existing study arrangement and do not sign a new site contract or commit unapproved expenditure.
The final calendar entry records a checked confirmation, not an automated external booking.
research_questions: What recurring request fields are still typed after availability is confirmed?

already_counted.description: Write actual resource facts in s3, check the final request in s4 and reconcile the response in s6.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final request, dates, named resources and site recipients; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Recurring request structure removes 20*0.08=1.6 hours less 0.4 upkeep, net 1.2. Cautious case: a new specialist site needs bespoke resource and timing fields, leaving only 0.5 hours of study-identification reuse and 0.1 net; actual availability checks and response handling stay manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use checked study facts and small clerical tools while retaining participant safety and site coordination.
skills_to_grow: Check participant-facing language against the study
Distinguish confirmed resource availability from a calendar slot
role.ambitious_version: A clinical research coordinator works from reliable study records while keeping participant decisions and physical clinical work with authorised people.
